name: Larry Glen Zelmer

events.type: Died of a heart aneurysm at home.

citations.text:
LARRY GLEN ZELMER Larry Glen Zelmer passed away unexpectedly at his home on Tuesday, April 25, 2006 at the age of 61. Born in Winnipeg, MB, Larry followed his family and moved to Vancouver in 1966. Larry will be remembered for his love of art, his culinary delights, his laughter, his energy for life and getting things done properly, his generosity of spirit, and his love for and dedication to his mother, family and friends. He was predeceased by his father Arvid in 2001. Larry will be greatly missed by his mother Lydia, his loving and devoted wife Elaine and her family (Ontario), and his brother Graham and wife Angela and their daughter Natasha (Ottawa). Larry was also a loving uncle to Graham's older children, Whitney (Ottawa) and her children, Lydia and Billie and Paul (Los Angeles), his wife Iulia and their son Luca. In celebration of his life, a memorial service will be held on Monday, May 1 at 1:30 p.m. at Mount Olive Lutheran Church, 2350 148th Street, Surrey. Reception to follow. In lieu of flowers, please make donations to your favourite charity.

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on Apr 29, 2006
